content:
anya: Heads up — onboarding Hermes-7B (int4) hit a weird quality regression on our summarization evals after the quant pass. Short repro below.

anya: baseline fp16 perplexity ~ 12.3, int4 after calibration ~ 12.9 but summarization ROUGE drop ~ 6-8 pts on a small eval set. Not expected.

mike: can you paste the quant config and tokenizer conversion steps?

anya: sure — quant: `perchannel=true, symmetric=false, clip_percentile=99.9, calibrate_batch=256`

anya: tokenizer: converted with our standard merges -> kept original vocab IDs, but had to map a few unicode variants (soft-hyphen U+00AD, kelvin-sign-looking char). I attached sample diffs.

sam: quick thought: are you seeing rotary phase mismatch or headwise scaling issues after projection reorder? iirc Hermes has custom proj layout (KV concat order differs).

leslie: echoing sam — Hermes projection layout is head-interleaved instead of block. If our loader assumed block order we might be permuting heads wrong which affects rotary application.

anya: interesting — the runtime loaded weights with a reshape `[num_heads, head_dim]` assuming block order. I can try swapping to interleaved.

mike: also check token id collisions: soft-hyphen was mapped to 173 and 417 in different sources? If tokenizer normalization changed, prefix caching can hit wrong KV entries.

anya: reproduction snippet I ran:
```
# load converted model
m = load_model('hermes7b-converted-int4.pt')
# sample prompt
out = m.generate('Summarize: ' + article, max_new_tokens=150)
```
Outputs are syntactically fine, but content is shorter and repeats.

leslie: try two quick experiments: 1) swap proj layout loader (interleave->block) and run a small lm-eval; 2) keep loader but force rotary scale=1.0 vs 0.75 to see sensitivity.

anya: running both now on a 100-sample subset. will post metrics.

ci-bot: ci job queued: hermes-onboard/triage/1755551111 run #12 (calibration + 2 layout variants). ETA ~ 14m :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sam: if that narrows it, we should add an adapter in the conversion pipeline to detect proj order from checkpoint metadata or shape heuristics.

mike: also add a quick tokenmap sanity check in the onboarding smoke: ensure id histogram matches original vocab and no duplicates. I can add that to the loader.

anya: quick results: layout-swap (interleaved->correct) recovers most perplexity (12.4) and ROUGE improves by ~5 pts, rotary-scale tweak had <1 pt impact.

leslie: so primary is proj-order. Nice catch.

anya: tokenmap check found 3 duplicate ids for combined NFKC normalization -> fixed mapping; that gave small additional bump.

sam: plan: 1) merge loader fix + tokenmap histogram check, 2) add automated layout-detection heuristic, 3) run full eval before marking onboard done.

anya: creating PR with fixes and tests. Assigning to @mike for code review.

mike: I got it, will review this afternoon. Thanks for the quick triage :thumbsup:

anya: thanks team — saved a day of weird mystery.
